card.name: Month and weekday names in dates
card.fires_on: Month names (often abbreviated, like Nov or Sag), weekday names, and time-of-year words that start a date or time span. They appear before a day number and year, or after 'between' and 'and'.

modes.label: Month before day and year
modes.description: A month name, often shortened, that begins a calendar date such as 'Nov 27, 201'.
modes.example: in the Himalayas being determined - May 08, 2010 - ESA's Hylas-1 released in space -<< Nov>> 27, 201

modes.label: Weekday starting a dated line
modes.description: A weekday name that opens a news-style date line before the day number and year.
modes.example: 29 February 2008 Biological organisms play a surprisingly large role in how rain and snow forms, a new study shows. <<Monday>>, 25 February 20

modes.label: End of a time span
modes.description: A month, season or time of day that closes a range after 'and'.
